Operator diagnostics view: combines synchronized timelines, spread (ΔT) and target-excess tracking, compressor modulation (Hz), water flow (l/min), defrost/evaporator behavior, and per-cycle energy analysis. Hover any chart for a shared timestamp; drag across a chart or click a cycle row to zoom in.

1 · Operation — when and for what purpose?

Exact state transitions from the three-way valve, compressor, defrost flag and backup heaters, overlaid with the COP curve (right axis). Vertical lines mark scheduler actions, mode changes and errors.

Selected time

Move over a chart
Select a timestamp to inspect operation, demand, hydraulics/spread, modulation and COP together.

2 · Heating water circuit — delivered temperature

Main water target, optional Zone 1 direct water target, flow (outlet) and return (inlet). Room-heating activity is shaded.

3 · Spread (ΔT), target excess & heating curve shift

All values in Kelvin (K): Spread ΔT (Flow − Return), Target excess (Flow − Target; compressor typically stops above +2 K), and Heating curve shift (K).

4 · Compressor modulation & current

Compressor frequency (Hz) and current (A) show whether the heat pump modulates down to minimum (~19–20 Hz) or ramps up.

5 · Hydraulics — water flow

Flow rate in l/min across heating, DHW and defrost circulation peaks.

6 · DHW — tank & charging temperatures

Tank setpoint and actual temperature continuously; flow and return temperatures while the three-way valve is in DHW position.

7 · Icing & defrost — outside vs. evaporator

Evaporator outlet temperature dropping well below outside temperature indicates coil icing; defrost intervals are shaded.

8 · Room heating — request and result

Room setpoint (when Zone 1 uses room control), actual Zone 1 temperature and outside temperature.

9 · Thermal output and electrical input

Uses water-side calculated thermal power (matching integrated kWh/COP totals) with fallback to Panasonic production.

10 · COP during operation

Separate instantaneous/bucket COP for room heating and DHW. Period cards above use integrated energy totals.

Storage settings

Loading…
Storage interval

How often a history sample is stored in RAM and on the SD card.

SD retention

Automatically removes old history and event CSV files. Unlimited uses the available SD-card space.

Electrical power source

Used for electrical energy and COP. Keep Panasonic selected unless an external MQTT power meter is configured.

Heating degree-day base temperature (°C)

Reference indoor/heating limit temperature for heating degree days (K·d) and hourly degree difference (e.g. 15 °C for well-insulated homes, 18 °C standard).
